Announcement detail

/courses/:courseId/announcements/:announcementId
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S03, S13

Read a specific published course announcement, including attachments and revision facts. Opening an update does not acknowledge a grade, approve a policy or start private messaging.

Announcement bodyAccessible authored text, links, diagrams and attachments; Referenced academic events/assessments with canonical links
FooterBack to preserved announcement filters; own read marker; Instructor edit link and published revision summary when supplied

Stay on announcementOpen external link
Permissions
  • Audience authorization is checked on direct URL and attachments.
  • TA cannot publish or change audience unless separately explicit authoring scope is later adopted.
  • No Reply privately or professor inbox action.
Responsive
  • Readable single text column; attachments and metadata wrap.
  • Back link remains near both heading and end for long announcements.
Accessibility
  • Authored heading hierarchy, link purpose and image descriptions are preserved.
  • Updated status is text; attachment type/size is announced.
Data
  • Published announcement/revision and exact attachment references.
  • Personal read state; canonical assessment/event links and visibility outcome.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Instructor draft editing leaves the learner's current published body unchanged.
  • An inaccessible attachment URL cannot bypass audience checks.
  • A failed read-marker update does not block reading or mislabel the announcement published state.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
